system_overview: This is a model-checking configuration module for the Chang-Roberts leader election algorithm. It instantiates the base Chang-Roberts specification with a specific number of processes and a deterministic identity assignment (sequential identifiers from 1 to N), making the state space finite for exhaustive verification.
actors_and_components: Same as the Chang-Roberts specification: N processes arranged in a unidirectional ring, each with a unique identifier. This module fixes the identifiers to be sequential integers starting from 1.
state_variables: Inherits all state variables from the Chang-Roberts specification: message sets per process, program counters, initiator flags, and election states. No additional state variables are introduced.
initial_state: Same as the Chang-Roberts specification, with identifiers assigned as the sequence 1, 2, 3, ..., N.
actions: Inherits all actions from the Chang-Roberts specification without modification.
safety_properties: Checks two invariants from the base specification: (1) type correctness ensuring all variables are within expected domains, and (2) correctness of the election outcome (the winner is the initiator with the smallest identifier and all others have lost).
liveness_properties: Checks the liveness property from the base specification: if any process is a candidate, eventually some process wins the election.
model_bounds: N is set to 3 processes. Identifiers are the sequence 1, 2, 3. Deadlock checking is disabled (to allow stuttering after termination).
additional_assumptions: By using sequential identifiers (1, 2, ..., N), the identity assignment is deterministic. The base specification allows arbitrary distinct identifiers, but this configuration uses the simplest possible assignment for efficient model checking.
